initialExam.title: Gujarat Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Gujarat Police Constable recruitment for Lokrakshak (constable) posts in Gujarat state police, armed police, and jail department.
initialExam.eligibility: HSC (12th pass) from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: GK & Current Affairs, Gujarat GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Gujarati/Hindi/English.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Physical Test. Merit.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit lrbgujarat2018.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension, Government quarters
